limitations: Development verification is not official correctness evaluation.
Original specification does not define unknown or high-impedance selector behavior; no expected behavior was asserted for those selectors.
implementation: Combinational one-bit mux selecting a for sel=0 and b for sel=1.
initial_snapshot: candidate_initial.sv preserved immediately after initial RTL creation; no RTL edits followed.
verification: Independent if/else oracle checks all eight binary combinations in both traversal directions plus eight selected/unselected X/Z data cases. Testbench has fatal mismatch checks and bounded timeout.
